name: singlet_embedding_viz_large_scale_embedding
title: Large-scale two-dimensional embedding
description: Computes a two-dimensional map of 10^5 to 10^7 cells from a PCA representation: openTSNE FFT or Barnes-Hut t-SNE, UMAP, or placement of all cells onto a subsample map. Writes coordinates, the neighbour graph and stage timings. Use it when a full map must fit a memory budget. Do not use it to score map fidelity; use the local neighbourhood preservation task for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

representation.description: obsm key of the input representation, normally 50 principal components of normalised expression.

method.description: Embedding method. opentsne_fft is the default; opentsne_bh suits small inputs; umap_cpu computes UMAP; subsample_project places cells on a subsample map.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for subsampling, approximate neighbour construction and negative sampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

knn.description: Neighbour graph settings shared by all methods; omit for method defaults.

backend.description: auto: exact below 1,000 cells (t-SNE) or 4,096 (UMAP), otherwise Annoy (t-SNE) or pynndescent (UMAP).

k.description: Neighbours per cell; default is 3 x perplexity for t-SNE and 15 for UMAP.

annoy_n_trees.description: Trees in the Annoy forest; more trees raise recall and memory.

opentsne.description: t-SNE optimisation settings for opentsne_fft, opentsne_bh and subsample_project.

perplexity.description: Effective neighbours for the input affinity; neighbour count k is 3 x perplexity.

learning_rate.description: Gradient step size; auto is N divided by exaggeration, which equals N by default.

early_exaggeration.description: Attraction multiplier during the early phase.

early_exaggeration_iter.description: Iterations in the early exaggeration phase.

n_iter.description: Iterations after the early phase; 750 matches the openTSNE benchmark schedule.

theta.description: Barnes-Hut opening angle; used only by opentsne_bh.

n_interpolation_points.description: Lagrange nodes per grid interval; used only by opentsne_fft.

min_num_intervals.description: Minimum number of grid intervals; used only by opentsne_fft.

dof.description: Degrees of freedom of the Student-t map kernel.

min_dist.description: Minimum distance in the map; 0.1 is the umap-learn default and differs from some wrappers.

spread.description: Scale of the map kernel, fitted together with min_dist.

n_epochs.description: Optimisation epochs; null uses 500 for N up to 10,000, otherwise 200.

subsample.description: subsample_project embeds a subsample with opentsne_fft, then places all other cells on that map.

n.description: Cells embedded with the full method before placing the rest; a design choice.

transform_perplexity.description: Perplexity used when placing each cell on the fixed map.

transform_k.description: Reference neighbours used when placing each cell.

transform_n_iter.description: Optimisation iterations when placing each cell.

memory_budget_gb.description: Fail before any work if the estimated peak memory exceeds this many GB; null disables the check.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obsm/X_opentsne_fft. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs with keys n_cells, method, knn_backend, k, seconds_knn, seconds_gradient, seconds_total, peak_rss_gb, nnz_P, knn_recall_sample and, for t-SNE, kl_approx. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
